instruction: Write inventory.py: walks data/ and writes inventory.txt — lines 'relpath size_bytes' sorted by path, directories excluded. Run it; data/ is already populated.
setup: mkdir -p data/sub && printf 'alpha' > data/a.txt && printf 'beta22' > data/sub/b.txt && printf 'g' > data/c.bin

oracle.script:
cat > inventory.py <<'EOF'
import os
from pathlib import Path
rows = []
for p in Path('data').rglob('*'):
    if p.is_file():
        rows.append((str(p.relative_to('data')), p.stat().st_size))
open('inventory.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f'{n} {s}' for n, s in sorted(rows)) + '\n')
EOF
python3 inventory.py
